title: Arrow tool captions: legible pill labels like the measure tool
notes: Objective: measure-redline > epic-uehjr1 (user epic: using the arrow tool to point to something should make it easy to create a legible caption in a pill with a shadow, similar to the measure tool). Next release. When the user points at something with the arrow tool, offer a caption rendered as a pill with a shadow, matching the legibility treatment the measure tool captions ship with, so redline callouts read cleanly over any screenshot. Start from the measure caption styling (docs/design/next-measure.md) for visual consistency; keep it non-destructive (styling applied at render time). Open a UX decision if caption entry/placement behavior is ambiguous beyond what the epic sentence settles.

log.note: Design settled from the epic sentence: drawing an arrow immediately offers a single-line caption (Return commits, Esc or empty skips), pill at the tail with the measure chip treatment + drop shadow; double-click or inspector field to edit later. No UX decision needed.

Core TDD done: caption fields on AnnotationContent (legacy-safe decode), captionAnchor/estimatedCaptionSize geometry, x0.55 chip tone (#FF3B30 -> #8C201A), builder frame reservation, hittable chip, restyled(caption:). 12 tests.

Render: measure pill extracted to shared PillRasterizer (+ optional drop shadow), caption drawn at the tail by AnnotationRasterizer. 4 pixel tests incl. shadow direction; measure suite untouched and green.

App: next-arrow-captions flag (Next-only, default on), inline caption session reusing the text editor overlay (single-line, centered on the pill anchor, chip-tinted), editingCaptionLayerID pill suppression, double-click entry, inspector Caption field. Full suite green: 912 tests. Dev bundle builds.

Shipped next-arrow-captions (Next-only, default on): drawing an arrow opens single-line caption entry (Return commits, Esc/empty skips); caption renders as a bordered pill with drop shadow at the arrow tail, chip tone derived from the arrow color like the measure defaults pair. Double-click or inspector Caption field to edit. Core geometry/model TDD (12 tests), shared PillRasterizer + 4 pixel tests (incl. shadow direction), full suite green at 912 tests, dev bundle builds. Committed 7d8f6da, pushed to main.
